mapper.select:
select a.id, a.app_name, a.app_url, a.sso_class, a.sso_method, a.icon, a.icon_seed, a.open_mode, a.maintainer_ids, a.vis_all, a.vis_role_ids, a.vis_sub_ids, a.vis_dept_ids, a.vis_user_ids, a.sort_no, a.qy as enable, a.remark, a.modedatacreater, a.modedatacreatedate, a.modedatacreatetime, a.modedatamodifier, a.modedatamodifydatetime, r.lastname as creator_name, m.lastname as modifier_name from ${appTable} a left join hrmresource r on r.id = a.modedatacreater left join hrmresource m on m.id = a.modedatamodifier
and (a.app_name like #{keyword} or a.app_url like #{keyword} or a.sso_class like #{keyword} or a.sso_method like #{keyword} or a.remark like #{keyword} or a.maintainer_ids like #{keyword})
and a.qy = #{enable}
order by a.sort_no, a.id

select id, app_name, app_url, sso_class, sso_method, icon, icon_seed, open_mode, maintainer_ids, vis_all, vis_role_ids, vis_sub_ids, vis_dept_ids, vis_user_ids, sort_no, qy as enable, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime from ${table} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (app_name, app_url, sso_class, sso_method, icon, icon_seed, open_mode, maintainer_ids, vis_all, vis_role_ids, vis_sub_ids, vis_dept_ids, vis_user_ids, sort_no, qy, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.appName}, #{e.appUrl}, #{e.ssoClass}, #{e.ssoMethod}, #{e.icon}, #{e.iconSeed}, #{e.openMode}, #{e.maintainerIds}, #{e.visAll}, #{e.visRoleIds}, #{e.visSubIds}, #{e.visDeptIds}, #{e.visUserIds}, #{e.sortNo}, #{e.enable}, #{e.remark}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
mapper.update: update ${table} set app_name = #{e.appName}, app_url = #{e.appUrl}, sso_class = #{e.ssoClass}, sso_method = #{e.ssoMethod}, icon = #{e.icon}, icon_seed = #{e.iconSeed}, open_mode = #{e.openMode}, maintainer_ids = #{e.maintainerIds}, vis_all = #{e.visAll}, vis_role_ids = #{e.visRoleIds}, vis_sub_ids = #{e.visSubIds}, vis_dept_ids = #{e.visDeptIds}, vis_user_ids = #{e.visUserIds}, sort_no = #{e.sortNo}, qy = #{e.enable}, remark = #{e.remark}, modedatamodifier = #{e.modedatamodifier}, modedatamodifydatetime = #{e.modedatamodifydatetime} where id = #{e.id}
